connector.name: Tokenlite Mysql MCP
connector.registryDescription: A secure, efficient, and intelligent MySQL server for the Model Context Protocol
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package tokenlite-mysql-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the andezdev account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: DB_HOST
env.description: MySQL Host address (defaults to localhost)

env.name: DB_PORT
env.description: MySQL Port (defaults to 3306)

env.name: DB_USER
env.description: MySQL Username (defaults to root)

env.name: DB_PASSWORD
env.description: MySQL Password (defaults to empty string)

env.name: DB_NAME
env.description: MySQL Database name

env.name: MCP_EXPLAIN_MAX_SCAN_ROWS
env.description: EXPLAIN guardrail: max estimated rows for unindexed full table scans before blocking (defaults to 1000). MCP_SAFE_QUERY_MAX_ROWS is a deprecated alias.

env.name: MCP_QUERY_ROW_LIMIT
env.description: Max rows returned per SELECT; injected as LIMIT at the AST level (defaults to 500)

env.name: MCP_SAFE_QUERY_MAX_ROWS
env.description: Deprecated alias for MCP_EXPLAIN_MAX_SCAN_ROWS

env.name: MCP_SAFE_QUERY_ENABLE_BLOCKING
env.description: Enable or disable the EXPLAIN guardrail (defaults to true)

env.name: MCP_METADATA_PATH
env.description: Absolute path to your custom metadata.json dictionary

env.name: MCP_TEMPLATES_PATH
env.description: Absolute path to your custom templates.json pre-approved queries

env.name: TOOL_PREFIX
env.description: Prefix for tool names, e.g., to run multiple instances (defaults to DB_NAME, e.g. mydb_). Only set to override.

env.name: MCP_RATE_LIMIT_RPM
env.description: Max tool invocations per minute, sliding window (defaults to 60). Set to 0 to disable.

env.name: MYSQL_QUERY_TIMEOUT
env.description: Max execution time for a query in milliseconds to protect against DoS (defaults to 15000)

env.name: MYSQL_CONNECTION_LIMIT
env.description: Max concurrent pool connections (defaults to 10)

env.name: MYSQL_CONNECT_TIMEOUT
env.description: Max time to wait for a connection socket to establish in milliseconds (defaults to 10000)

env.name: MYSQL_RETRY_ATTEMPTS
env.description: Max retries on transient connection errors (defaults to 3)

env.name: MYSQL_RETRY_DELAY_MS
env.description: Base delay in milliseconds for exponential backoff between retries (defaults to 1000)

env.name: MYSQL_QUEUE_LIMIT
env.description: Max queued requests when all pool connections are busy to prevent memory leak (defaults to 50)

env.name: MCP_DDL_CACHE_TTL
env.description: Time-to-live in seconds for cached DDL statements (defaults to 60)

env.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
env.description: Minimum severity level for MCP log notifications (defaults to info). Levels: debug, info, notice, warning, error, critical, alert, emergency

env.name: ALLOW_INSERT_OPERATION
env.description: Enable INSERT and REPLACE queries (defaults to false)

env.name: ALLOW_UPDATE_OPERATION
env.description: Enable UPDATE queries (defaults to false)

env.name: ALLOW_DELETE_OPERATION
env.description: Enable DELETE and TRUNCATE queries (defaults to false)

env.name: ALLOW_DDL_OPERATION
env.description: Enable Data Definition Language queries like CREATE, ALTER, DROP, RENAME (defaults to false)

env.name: DB_SSL
env.description: Enable TLS for the MySQL connection (defaults to false)

env.name: DB_SSL_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED
env.description: Reject self-signed or untrusted TLS certificates when DB_SSL is true (defaults to true)
